Processing = UPLOADED or PROCESSING; the list polls while any row is Processing. Failed: fixed failure sentence per code, Retry reprocesses the same file.
Cursor paging: Load more. Members see masked departments. 12 / 50 documents (quota default). Row click opens detail (V2-32).
OWNER/ADMIN only. Only an OWNER can make or change an OWNER (403 for ADMIN). The last OWNER cannot be removed (409 LAST_OWNER).
Employee ID is unique per workspace (409 EMPLOYEE_CODE_TAKEN). Departments are flat and managed in V2-33.
Link valid 7 days, single use, revocable.
